title: The Shell Necklace of the Defenders

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE III: DEFENSE, RAIDS AND THE FALLEN (LCC-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
"If anyone comes to raid our homeland, we'll be ready." Isola's people are peaceful but no pushovers: stamping dances and war chants, watch fires and plans, raids fended off or not, prisoners and bargains, and how the village honors those who defended it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The village wants to give a shell necklace to everyone who fought: give them to the warriors only, or to everyone who helped.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After the raid was driven off, (subject) has carved a shell necklace for every warrior who stood on the beach. (friend) points out that the healers worked all night, the cooks fed everyone, and the old people kept the children calm in the caves. They all helped too. Who should get the necklaces?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The necklaces go to the warriors, as (subject) planned. The warriors wear them proudly. The healers and cooks say they do not mind, and mostly mean it. (friend) quietly makes a few extra for the healers anyway.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) sighs and gets carving. It takes the whole season. By the end, half the village is wearing a shell necklace, including a very small child who carried water all night. The warriors decide they like it better this way.
